title: skilldrop reviewer subagent frontmatter
$comment: RFC-0012 / RFC-0029. agents/<name>.md is a single markdown file whose YAML frontmatter is already Claude Code's format; the body is the system prompt. The CLI projects this into each target's own shape (Kiro JSON, Codex TOML, Copilot .agent.md), so these four fields are the portable core.

name.description: Must equal the filename stem. A rename that misses one silently breaks every delegation pointing here.

description.description: What routes a delegation to this agent. Required — without it the agent is unreachable.

tools.description: Comma-separated tool names. Recommended; the CLI maps these per target and warns where a tool has no equivalent.

model.description: Recommended. A hint the target may honour or ignore.
